chunks: They glorify Him night and day, nor cease.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the angels glorify God night and day without ceasing?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing the continuous glorification of the angels, who are perpetually engaged in divine worship without the distraction of sleep or worldly concerns. This perpetual state (la yafturuna) underscores the concept of *dahr* (eternal time) in the celestial realm, contrasting with the temporal nature of human existence. It serves as a model for believers to strive for consistency in their own acts of worship, mirroring the unwavering devotion of the heavenly hosts.
